rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice, especially when saliva is visibly running or someone is drooling.

example.english: They salivate when they see so much roast meat.
example.traditional: 佢見到咁多燒味，流口水喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 siu1 mei2 lau4 hau2 seoi2 laa3

rows.note: Use this in medical, scientific, or otherwise formal contexts when you mean the production of saliva precisely.

example.english: People salivate when they are stimulated by the smell of food.
example.traditional: 人受到食物氣味刺激時，會分泌唾液。
example.jyutping: jan4 sau6 dou3 sik6 mat6 hei3 mei6 ci3 gik1 si4 wui5 fan1 bei3 toe5 jik6
